item.title: Core Keeper FAQ — Answers to the Most Common Questions
item.description: New to Core Keeper or stuck on a mechanic? This Core Keeper FAQ answers the most common questions in one place, organized by topic. Every answer is based on our verified game data — if you need more depth, each section links to the matching tool, guide or database page. FAQ by topic Getting Started — what the game is, how to begin, boss order, multiplayer Farming & Crops — growth times, golden crops, harvest chance, the best money crops Fishing — how to fish, water types, rare fish, bait Bosses & Combat — boss order, guaranteed drops, farming bosses Mods & Installation — Steam Workshop vs mod.
